'''Niu''' is male miner who works at [[Tiger's Maw Mine]]. 
He can be found located outside of [[Huaxu Academy]] around 9AM to 12:59AM.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Niu:''' [[Huaxu Academy]] is filled with talented people... I'm so jealous.
:{{DIcon}} Do you want to join the Academy too?
:'''Niu:''' Who wouldn't be jealous of working in a nice, bright office, doing research that shapes the future?
:'''Niu:''' And the pay must be great! I want that kind of life too...
:'''Niu:''' I've actually been using my free time to study Imperial Academy courses, and I'm almost done.
:'''Niu:''' As soon as I graduate, I'm leaving that filthy mine and getting a decent job.
:{{DIcon}} Actually, it's not that bad.
:'''Niu:''' Yeah, it's pretty far from the life I dreamed of. Definitely don't want to be a miner though.
----
;(Night before completing [[Shadow of the Past]].) 
:'''Niu:''' So cold... So cold...
:{{DIcon}} Are you okay?!
:'''Niu:''' Even though it's not cold out, I feel like I'm freezing every night.
:'''Niu:''' I've been to many doctors, but no one can figure it out, so I had to turn to Liuqing for help.
:'''Niu:''' He thinks my symptoms might be caused by Tacet Discords, which can make you hallucinate... but I haven't been near any recently.
:'''Niu:''' I wonder if it's related to the weird stuff going on in the mine lately...
:{{DIcon}} What strange things happened?
:'''Niu:''' Not sure, but if you're free, you could check out the Tiger's Maw.
----
;(Night after completing [[Shadow of the Past]].) 
:'''Niu:''' I didn't expect such a terrifying Tacet Discord to be hidden under the mine...
:'''Niu:''' Thanks for getting rid of them all, otherwise I wouldn't know when my hallucinations would go away.
:'''Niu:''' But [[Liuqin|Liuqing]] told me to come here for his inspection tonight.
:'''Niu:''' He's worried about any side effects I might have, but also really curious about what happened.
:'''Niu:''' Ah, the spirit of a true researcher, I get it.
{{Dialogue End}}
